title: "group" privacy behaves identically to "private" in deaddrop.py
description: In _drop_visible (line 402-406), both "private" and "group" privacy levels use the same check: context_id == drop.get("context"). This means only the creator can see group drops, not other group members. Either "group" semantics are unimplemented, or there is missing group membership logic. File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/deaddrop.py line 404
